STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast/brunch plate: waffles with a scrambled-egg-style mixture containing broccoli and crumbled white cheese (feta-like), plus sliced sausage rounds on the side.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A square white dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 x (13)^2 ≈ 530 cm². The plate is squarish, so this is approximate.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Waffles (about 3 pieces, golden, plain)
- Scrambled egg with broccoli and onion/vegetable bits
- Crumbled white cheese (feta-like)
- Sausage slices (about 6 rounds, cooked)

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate area, sums to food coverage):
- Waffles: ~30% (159 cm²)
- Scrambled egg/vegetable mix: ~12% (64 cm²)
- Crumbled cheese: ~8% (42 cm²)
- Sausage slices: ~7% (37 cm²)
Total food coverage ≈ 57%.

STEP 5 - Volume (area x typical height):
- Waffles: 159 cm² x 1.8 cm ≈ 286 ml
- Egg/vegetable mix: 64 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 96 ml
- Cheese: 42 cm² x 1.2 cm ≈ 50 ml
- Sausage: 37 cm² x 1.0 cm ≈ 37 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density):
- Waffles (bread-like, ~0.5 g/ml given their open grid structure): 286 x 0.5 ≈ 143 g. Waffles are airy, so a density near 0.5 is used here as the bulk density.
- Egg/vegetable mix (dense, ~0.9): 96 x 0.9 ≈ 86 g
- Cheese (~0.9): 50 x 0.9 ≈ 45 g
- Sausage (~0.9): 37 x 0.9 ≈ 33 g
Total ≈ 307 g.

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Waffles: 143 g x 290 kcal/100 g ≈ 415 kcal
- Egg/vegetable mix (egg with some oil and broccoli): 86 g x 150 kcal/100 g ≈ 129 kcal
- Cheese (feta-like): 45 g x 265 kcal/100 g ≈ 119 kcal
- Sausage: 33 g x 300 kcal/100 g ≈ 99 kcal
Total ≈ 762 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 300 g of food across a mostly covered-in-part dinner plate, with three waffle pieces, a generous egg-and-cheese heap, and six sausage rounds, is plausible. Around 750 kcal fits a full breakfast plate of this kind. Estimates are rough given the single photo angle and unknown portion depth.
